source_caption_text:
GTA 6 BETTER start like this 😭😂🔥

GTA 6 is only 6 DAYS away, and the numbers are already massive 🤯💰

Sensor Tower estimates over 10 MILLION preorders and more than $1 BILLION in preorder revenue ahead of launch. Those are third-party estimates—not official Rockstar totals 🔥

For perspective, GTA 5 crossed $1 billion in its first THREE DAYS after release. GTA 6’s estimated preorder revenue has already passed that milestone before players can even start the story 😭🎮

The hype started at record-breaking levels too: its first trailer pulled in 90.4 MILLION YouTube views in just 24 hours. DFC Intelligence has projected roughly 40 million copies sold and $3.2 BILLION in revenue during the game’s first year 👀📈
